environment: Disposable Docker containers with external networking disabled, isolated Forge and Codex homes and a synthetic loopback OpenRouter endpoint. No native Codex credential or token store was present. Only the existing user-granted SessionStart and PreToolUse trust records were copied at their original paths.

cases.stop_configuration_reason: Stop requires measured Codex 0.162.1 and a current verified turn/Stop enrollment receipt.

patch_fixture.model: gpt-5.5 (from the pinned binary’s bundled patch-capable catalog)
patch_fixture.native_tool_boundary: The native patch returned Failed to write file after the hook allowed it. Feedback delivery is established by the subsequent Responses request.

reviewer_requests.path_note: The fixture supplied a base ending in /v1. The Messages proxy appended /v1/messages, and the synthetic upstream accepted that path.

cases.stop_configuration_reason: The available user trust does not cover UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse and Stop. Forge refused before reviewer dispatch.

patch_fixture.model: gpt-5.5 (from the pinned binary’s bundled patch-capable catalog)
patch_fixture.native_tool_boundary: The native patch returned Failed to write file after the hook allowed it. Feedback delivery is established by the subsequent Responses request.

procedure: Install the versioned Linux arm64 npm distribution after matching the published SHA-512, register user hooks in the isolated home, and replay existing trust using tests/fixtures/codex_enrollment.py.
Start codex-responses-openrouter against synthetic Responses SSE, then run forge runtime preflight codex --verify-enrollment --proxy hook-probe --json.

Start an advisory Codex session from a synthetic Claude planner. For the patch trial, configure the bundled gpt-5.5 default, allow the full tool declaration on the isolated listener, and offer one native apply_patch call.

On a separate Codex session enable the permissive tdd bundle and resume. Inspect the next Responses request for policy feedback. Configure an approved plan with --supervisor-proxy reviewer-probe and send a second patch. The Claude reviewer CLI fixture posts its input to the selected Messages proxy.
Request --trigger stop before configuring the ordinary reviewer and record Forge’s refusal when turn and Stop trust is absent.
